title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 1.75 cm off the optical axis.

title: Use of Focal Length
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the focal length of the diverging lens in their calculations.

title: Angle Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the tangent function to calculate the distance based on the angle of incidence.

title: Image Type Identification
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify that the image is virtual and located in the focal plane.

title: Sign Convention
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may make a sign mistake regarding the focal length of the diverging lens.
